svg.title: B1 PORTS A from above
svg.text: FRONT EDGE (lid side): the card slides in from here; the RJ11 jacks overhang it, mouths toward the lid
BACK EDGE (snapped, filed flat): 1x30 header (column J, rows 1-30, pin 27 pulled: the slot key) plugs into the backplane
B1 PORTS A: from above, 9 px/mm; SolderFul 81.3 x 50.8 mm with the back rails snapped off: 81.3 x 41.91 mm [TBD-MEASURE]
sensor port 1 clock (SCL) at the jack
sensor port 1 data (SDA) at the jack
sensor port 2 clock (SCL) at the jack
sensor port 2 data (SDA) at the jack
sensor port 3 clock (SCL) at the jack
sensor port 3 data (SDA) at the jack
spare bus line (for the charger interrupt)
solid line: jumper, wire or lead on top, as routed
dashed line: wire on the underside, as routed
ring on the front edge: lead leaving the card (to the charger, the pack)
diamond: pad with a soldered lead
grey dashed box: plug or service keep-out
